items.title: October Natural Gas Forwards Open $2 Gap Between Appalachia, Southeast
items.summary: Natural gas forward prices in the eastern United States are diverging heading into the end of the year, with Appalachian supply hubs sinking while constrained Southeast markets command some of their strongest premiums.
